title: A function that prints
description:
Not every function returns a value. Write a `void` function named `printLine` that prints a row of 20 dashes followed by a new line:

```
--------------------
```

Then the `main` that is already written will call it twice, around a title.
hints: The function has to appear above `main`, because the compiler reads top to bottom and must know `printLine` before it is called.
